newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: BOOKOVER DEAL HOISTS HOUSEWARES AT START.
newsitem.headline: BOOKOVER DEAL HOISTS HOUSEWARES AT START.

text.p: A bookover deal involving 6.9 million shares by stockbrokers Martindale Stacey du Toit swelled early volumes in stores firm Housewares Group Ltd, dealers said.
Martindale Stacey said the deal was worth around seven million rand but did not elaborate further.
Housewares was last up two cents at 108 cents with total volumes at 6.9 million. It was the highest volume leader on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange in the first 30 minutes of trade.

The firm, an investment holding company, conducts its trading activities though its subsidiaries Housewares Ltd, Goodgold and Glomail which sell -- among other things -- crockery, cutlery, linen and jewellery.
